description: This file defines tooltip utility functions and a Tooltips class for displaying and dismissing tooltips in a React Native project, including default properties, positioning, and show/dismiss methods.

classes.name: Tooltips
classes.description: A class providing static methods to show and dismiss tooltips with configurable options.

methods.name: Show
methods.description: Displays a tooltip at a target node with specified properties.

methods.name: Dismiss
methods.description: Dismisses the tooltip associated with a target node.
